sections.title: Transcript
paragraphs: Your Gmail inbox is stressing you out. Let me show you something insane. This open- source tool lets you instantly clean up your Gmail, unsubscribe, delete junk, and mark thousands of emails as read, all with one click. First, it scans your inbox and finds every newsletter you never signed up for. Hit bulk unsubscribe. Boom, gone. Next, see which senders spam you the most. Tap delete by sender and wipe hundreds of emails instantly. Got 4,000 unread emails? Yeah, we all do. Tap mark all read. Done. Zero anxiety. And the best part, it's 100% local.
